arguments.command:
python -c "
from more_itertools import seekable, relative_seek
import io

# Test seekable with relative seeking
data = b'0123456789'
s = seekable(io.BytesIO(data))

# Read some data
print('Read:', s.read(3))  # should be '012'
print('Position:', s.tell())

# Seek relative to current position
s.relative_seek(2)
print('After relative_seek(2), Position:', s.tell())
print('Read next 3:', s.read(3))

# Test standalone relative_seek function
f = io.BytesIO(data)
result = list(relative_seek(f, 5))  # Should read from position 5 onwards
print('relative_seek result:', result)
"
